title: A nonzero polynomial over a field has finitely many monic divisors
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $p\in F[T]$ be a nonzero polynomial [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Then the set $\{d\in F[T]: d\text{ is monic and }d\mid p\}$ is finite. Here monic means that the leading coefficient is $1$, and $d\mid p$ means that $p=de$ for some $e\in F[T]$.
